conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for approximately 1.5% monthly return. The focus is on preserving capital by eliminating leveraged positions and reducing concentration, leading to lower expected drawdowns.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% monthly return. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality new position, aiming for risk-first growth.
